diagnosis.rationale: The passive undiluted trace grows approximately exponentially through 5 h (0.0097→0.5139) and then abruptly becomes a noisy flat line near 0.52, which is inconsistent with continued smooth growth and suggests high-density under-reading/saturation. Retained 18 h aliquots read at 10×, 20×, and 50× dilution gave means 0.1931, 0.1023, and 0.0367; dilution-corrected OD600 estimates are 1.93, 2.05, and 1.84 (mean ≈1.94). These are internally consistent within ~10% and are ~3.6× the undiluted 18 h reading of 0.5376, so the undiluted final-hours readings substantially underestimate biomass.
